neighbours.label: 'together' meaning jointly or collectively, where separate parts combine into one whole or act as one agent (taken together, add up together, together founded); 'together' meaning side by side or in each other's company stays low

The two companies merged and together now employ ten thousand people.

Each clue is weak, but together they point to the same suspect.
The three villages pooled their money and together built a bridge.
